report.answer_text:
The Oklahoma City Thunder won the 2025 NBA championship, and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was Finals MVP.
The series: The Western Conference champion Thunder beat the Eastern Conference champion Indiana Pacers in seven games.[1] The Thunder won Game 7 by 103–91 at Paycom Center.[2]
The MVP: Gilgeous-Alexander averaged 30.3 points, 4.6 rebounds and 5.6 assists per game in the series.[2] He was the first Canadian to win the award.[1]
Added context: He became the fourth player in NBA history to win the MVP award, the Finals MVP award and the scoring title in the same season.[3] It was the Thunder's first NBA championship.[4] It was also their first since relocating from Seattle to Oklahoma City.[3]
